name: runCorpusBackfill

versions.rationale: Measures backfill on a repository that adopts Poetics late, which #64 asks for: the earlier eval ran only on this repository, whose TSDoc and recorded rationale make its results an upper bound. It runs the snapshot offline in a throwaway clone, then records and commits the units and times a full first-parent history walk, deletions included.

docs:
Clones `source` (a full clone of the corpus repository) at the corpus commit,
writes a config for its scope, and runs the snapshot backfill offline. Then
it records and commits the units and walks the first-parent history for
their prehistory, deletions included. The clone is thrown away.
